summary: Read-only work-thread recovery for fuzzy or exact prior-work targets. /z-resume selects a bounded plan/run/worktree/branch/artifact/repo target, reports evidence-backed state and ambiguity, recommends safe continuations without executing them, and delegates --report to /z-report only after selection.

entry_points.summary: Answers what the user was doing, what state it is actually in, and how to continue safely.
Parses run, slug, plan, branch, worktree, artifact, repo, select token, current/active, latest/last, and fuzzy topic controls.
Calls scripts/resume-context.py as the deterministic gather/score/packet producer with bounded repo/lookback inputs.
Builds the deterministic /z-resume packet by gathering bounded evidence, ranking candidates, applying ambiguity/reportability gates, and emitting selected target context.
CLI entry point for active-plan registry reads and advisory overlap/status records that /z-resume treats as live state evidence.
Resolves report targets and accepts --resume-context so a selected /z-resume packet can be projected into the /z-report context bundle.
Packet carries query, repo identity, lookback, source status, evidence records, candidates, ambiguity, selected target, warnings, citations, and suggestions.
Providers include plan/run artifacts, active registry, git/worktree/branch evidence, validated session/handoff files, and memory/follow-up side evidence.
Stops before narrative/report rendering when candidates are ambiguous, thin, conflicting, cross-repo, or not reportable.
Selected packets render target, repo/worktree/branch, state, confidence, latest consensus, changed state, warnings, and safe next options.
Only selected, exact, non-ambiguous targets may hand off to report-context/report-synth through the existing z-report machinery.
Tool-less Haiku subagent for bounded Phase 4 cheap inference; summarizes only the supplied candidate/evidence payload.
Human-oriented evidence hierarchy, boundaries, examples, key entry points, and side-evidence rules.

evidence_hierarchy: Exact user selectors after validation: run, slug/plan, branch, worktree, artifact, repo, select token.
Current repo identity plus configured z-harness state bases.
Active-plan registry records for live phase/current task/heartbeat/held paths/wait edges/worktree/branch/repo.
Plan and run artifacts: INTENT/SPEC/PLAN/TASKS/FIX/LEDGER, archive artifacts, REPORT/context/run-brief/events/decisions/follow-ups.
Git/worktree/branch associations backed by repo id, registry, HEAD/commit, artifacts, or explicit user input.
Validated session/handoff evidence when schema, timestamps, hashes, next-step state, and referenced files agree.
Optional bounded cheap inference stored under subagent_judgments only.
Memories, follow-ups, and fuzzy topic text as side evidence only.
invariants: /z-resume is read-only: no edits, no registry mutation, no branch/worktree/service/database mutation, no command execution handoff.
resume-context.py is deterministic and owns selection packets; consumers must not infer hidden targets from prose or filesystem scans when selected_target is null.
Selection comes before story: interactive ambiguity asks one bounded selection question; noninteractive ambiguity returns needs_selection with selected_target null.
--report may invoke/reuse z-report machinery only after an unambiguous or explicit target selection and exact report_target are available.
Branch/worktree matching is associative evidence only; substring/basename matches alone are insufficient proof.
Memories, follow-ups, cheap inference, and fuzzy user text never prove current state, landed state, completion, or branch/worktree ownership.
Cross-repo candidates must carry source/repo citations, and broader discovery is capped and explicit via --repo or --all-repos.
Safe next options are advisory and copyable; /z-resume never auto-dispatches the recommended command.
Phase 4 cheap inference is capped at MAX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_CALLS (2) and the resume-cluster agent is tool-less/read-only over only the supplied packet.

adjacent_boundaries.use_for: Active-plan registry status and path overlaps for currently registered runs.
adjacent_boundaries.resume_boundary: /z-resume consumes registry evidence but also recovers bounded historical artifacts, sessions, branches, reports, and cross-repo context.

adjacent_boundaries.use_for: Narrative for a known run/slug/PR/range/base/worktree target.
adjacent_boundaries.resume_boundary: Fuzzy prior-work recovery routes to /z-resume; /z-resume --report delegates only after selected target resolution.

adjacent_boundaries.use_for: Code terrain reconstruction, entry points, seams, and MAP-like source surveys.
adjacent_boundaries.resume_boundary: /z-resume reconstructs work-thread state, not code architecture; recommend /z-explore only after selected evidence says terrain is the gap.

adjacent_boundaries.use_for: One-shot cited teaching of a file, symbol, subsystem, repo orientation, or behavior lens.
adjacent_boundaries.resume_boundary: Route work-thread continuation or prior-run reorientation to /z-resume.

adjacent_boundaries.use_for: Interactive progressive tutoring over code/system understanding.
adjacent_boundaries.resume_boundary: Learning-session staging is not plan/run/worktree recovery; use /z-resume for what-was-I-doing continuity.

adjacent_boundaries.use_for: Resume a known attended chain run after its handoff predicate validates.
adjacent_boundaries.resume_boundary: /z-resume can find/cite the likely attended run but does not re-enter the chain.

adjacent_boundaries.use_for: Resume a known overnight run id/state.
adjacent_boundaries.resume_boundary: /z-resume can find the likely run id and cite state, but it does not resume unattended orchestration.

gotchas: Recency filters discovery and ranking; it does not prove current truth or hide older canonical linked decisions attached to a selected candidate.
Provider truncation, stale session/handoff files, malformed artifacts, dirty/divergent worktrees, and close-score competitors become warnings or ambiguity, not silent choices.
Noninteractive ambiguous output must not invoke report-context.py, report-synth, /z-report, or any report renderer.
Worktree-backed selected reports must use --worktree target args; non-current-repo selections must not fall back to current-base --run or --slug resolution.
SESSION_CONTEXT.md is live side evidence only when freshly linked by a valid session/handoff artifact; otherwise it is stale side evidence.
